items.look_for: format.json: commands 0x00-0x7f note / 0x80 rest / 0x81 instrument / 0x90 tempo / 0xff end; period table starts 1440,0 and ends 135,28 (gdriver.asm:204,222); duration row 0 is 26880..210 (gdriver.asm:228); instrument words 0x0000 x4, 0x0005, 0x0202, 0x0101, 0x0103, 0x0004, 0x0504, 0x0100, 0x0500 (fmain.c:670-672). track_00.json: every event carries its raw byte pair next to the decoded meaning.
items.title: Music event format + 28 decoded tracks

items.look_for: Combat theme (tracks 4-7): what plays while battleflag is set. song_1 is the 4-voice mix.

items.look_for: Overworld night theme (tracks 8-11): what plays outdoors when lightlevel <= 120. song_2 is the 4-voice mix.

items.look_for: Title/intro theme (tracks 12-15): started by main() right after the score loads and heard over the intro pages until stopscore() at fmain.c:1244. song_3 is the 4-voice mix.

items.look_for: Astral (spirit) plane theme (tracks 16-19): what plays inside the box (0x2400,0x8200)-(0x3100,0x8a00), the 'astral plane' extent. song_4 is the 4-voice mix.
items.title: Song 4 — astral plane

items.look_for: Indoor theme (tracks 20-23): what plays in region 8 (inside of buildings) and 9 (dungeons and caves). Rendered with the default instrument 10 (0x0100); the region-9 swap to 0x0307 is not modelled. song_5 is the 4-voice mix.
items.title: Song 5 — indoors / dungeons

items.look_for: Death theme (tracks 24-27): what plays when the hero's vitality reaches 0. song_6 is the 4-voice mix.
items.title: Song 6 — death

items.look_for: 8 waveforms of 128 signed samples (-128..127) from v6 bytes 0-1023; octave_slices lists the 64/32/16/8-byte cycles at offsets 0/64/96/112; v6_unread holds the bytes the game never reads: 1024-2047 and the last 20 (fmain.c:931-936; the Seek mode 0 is OFFSET_CURRENT).
items.title: Instrument waveforms (v6)

items.look_for: 10 envelopes of 256 bytes from v6 bytes 2048-4607 (Seek(file,S_WAVBUF,0) is OFFSET_CURRENT, fmain.c:933); byte 0 is the starting volume, one byte per vertical blank follows, and hold_from marks the first >= 128 (negative = hold) byte.
items.title: Volume envelopes (v6)

Listen to the song_N.wav mixes (and single-voice track_NN.wav renders) to recognise each theme; the WAVs are rough non-authoritative renders (see music/previews/README.md).
